en.s: The Battle of Losecoat Field (also known as the Battle of Empingham) was fought on 12 March 1470, during the Wars of the Roses. en.s: The siege of Klis or Battle of Klis (Croatian: Opsada Klisa, Bitka kod Klisa, Turkish: Klise Kuşatması) was a siege of Klis Fortress in the Kingdom of Croatia within Habsburg monarchy. The siege of the fortress, which lasted for more than two decades, and the final battle near Klis in 1537, were fought as a part of the Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the defending Croatian–Habsburg forces under the leadership of Croatian feudal lord Petar Kružić, and the attacking Ottoman army under the leadership of the Ottoman general Murat-beg Tardić. After the decisive Ottoman victory at the Battle of Krbava Field in 1493, and especially after the Battle of Mohács in 1526, the Croats continued defending themselves against the Ottoman attacks. The Ottoman conquest during the early years of the 16th century prompted the formation of the Uskoks, which were led by Croatian captain Petar Kružić, also called Prince of Klis. As a part of the Habsburg defensive system, Uskoks used the base at Klis as an important defensive position. They fought almost alone against the Ottomans, and for more than two decades defended the fortress against the Ottoman attacks. After the final battle, which resulted in an Ottoman victory and in Petar Kružić's death, the Klis defenders, who were lacking in water supplies, finally surrendered to the Ottomans in exchange for their freedom on 12 March 1537.

zh.s: 克利斯围城战又称克利斯战役，围攻对象是哈布斯堡王朝克罗地亚王国境内的克利斯要塞。围城持续二十多年，1537年在要塞附近爆发最后一战，是奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争的一部分。克罗地亚—哈布斯堡守军由克罗地亚封建领主彼得·克鲁日奇率领，奥斯曼军队则由将军穆拉特贝伊·塔尔迪奇指挥。1493年克尔巴瓦平原战役、尤其是1526年莫哈奇战役后，克罗地亚人继续抵御奥斯曼进攻。16世纪初奥斯曼征服促成了乌斯科克人的形成，他们由克罗地亚队长彼得·克鲁日奇（又称克利斯亲王）领导。作为哈布斯堡防御体系的一部分，乌斯科克人以克利斯为重要据点，几乎独自抵抗奥斯曼人二十多年。最后一战以奥斯曼获胜、克鲁日奇阵亡告终。缺水的守军最终于1537年3月12日投降，以换取自由。

en.s: The Battle of Penco took place on March 12, 1550, between 60,000 Mapuche under the command of their toqui Ainavillo with his Araucan and Tucapel allies and Pedro de Valdivia's 200 Spaniards on horse and afoot with many yanakuna including 300 Mapochoes auxiliaries under their leader Michimalonco, defending their newly raised fort at Penco. en.s: The Williamite War in Ireland took place from March 1689 to October 1691. Fought between Jacobite supporters of James II and those of his successor, William III, it resulted in a Williamite victory. It is generally viewed as a related conflict of the 1688 to 1697 Nine Years' War. The November 1688 Glorious Revolution replaced the Catholic James with his Protestant daughter Mary II and her husband William, who ruled as joint monarchs of England, Ireland, and Scotland.

en.s: The Battle of Intombe (also Intombi or Intombi River Drift) was an action fought on 12 March 1879, between Zulu troops loyal to Mbilini waMswati and British soldiers and African civilian conductors, drivers and voorloopers (scouts) defending a convoy of wagons on the road from Derby to Lüneburg. en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 12 March 1921 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The incumbent government, led by Premier James Mitchell of the Nationalist Party and supported by the Country Party and National Labor Party, won a second term in government against the Labor Party opposition, led by Opposition Leader Philip Collier.

zh.s: 1921年3月12日，西澳大利亚州举行选举，选出立法议会全部50名议员。詹姆斯·米切尔领导的国民党政府在乡村党和国民工党支持下，击败由反对党领袖菲利普·科利尔领导的工党，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: In California, the St. Francis Dam fails; the resulting floods kill 431 people
en.s: The St. Francis Dam, or the San Francisquito Dam, was a concrete gravity-arch dam located in San Francisquito Canyon in northern Los Angeles County, California, United States, that was built between 1924 and 1926. The dam failed catastrophically in 1928, killing at least 431 people in the subsequent flood, in what is considered to have been one of the worst American civil engineering disasters of the 20th century and the third-greatest loss of life in California history.

zh.s: 圣弗朗西斯大坝又称圣弗朗西斯基托大坝，是一座混凝土重力拱坝，位于美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶县北部的圣弗朗西斯基托峡谷，建于1924至1926年。大坝于1928年灾难性溃决，随后引发洪水，造成至少431人死亡。这是美国20世纪最严重的土木工程灾难之一，也是加利福尼亚州死亡人数第三高的灾难。

en.s: The Turenki rail accident occurred on 12 March 1940, at 05:30 local time (03:30 UTC) near Turenki, Finland, and remains the worst rail accident in Finnish history. A troop train carrying soldiers of the 71st Supply Company and horses south from Loimaa to Viipuri collided with a northbound freight train. The two trains were travelling at 40 km/h (25 mph) and 25–30 km/h (15–19 mph) respectively at the time of collision.

zh.s: 1940年3月12日当地时间05时30分（协调世界时03时30分），芬兰图伦基附近发生该国历史上最严重的铁路事故。一列运送第71补给连士兵和马匹的军列，从洛伊马向南开往维堡时，与一列北行货运列车相撞。撞击时，两列车的速度分别为每小时40公里（25英里）和25至30公里（15至19英里）。

en.s: The Moscow Peace Treaty was signed by Finland and the Soviet Union on 12 March 1940, and the ratifications were exchanged on 21 March. It marked the end of the 105-day Winter War, upon which Finland ceded border areas to the Soviet Union. The treaty was signed by Vyacheslav Molotov, Andrei Zhdanov and Aleksandr Vasilevsky for the Soviet Union, and Risto Ryti, Juho Kusti Paasikivi, Rudolf Walden and Väinö Voionmaa for Finland.

zh.s: 芬兰与苏联于1940年3月12日签署《莫斯科和平条约》，并于3月21日交换批准书。条约结束了持续105天的冬季战争，芬兰将边境地区割让给苏联。苏联方面由维亚切斯拉夫·莫洛托夫、安德烈·日丹诺夫和亚历山大·华西列夫斯基签署；芬兰方面由里斯托·吕蒂、尤霍·库斯蒂·巴锡基维、鲁道夫·瓦尔登和维诺·沃伊翁马签署。

en.s: The Battle of Java (Invasion of Java, Operation J) was a battle of the Pacific theatre of World War II. It occurred on the island of Java from 28 February – 12 March 1942. It involved forces from the Empire of Japan, which invaded on 28 February 1942, and Allied personnel. Allied commanders signed a formal surrender at Japanese headquarters at Bandung on 12 March.

zh.s: 爪哇岛战役又称爪哇岛入侵或J行动，是二战太平洋战场的一场战役，于1942年2月28日至3月12日在爪哇岛发生。日本帝国军队于2月28日发起入侵，与盟军交战。3月12日，盟军指挥官在万隆的日军司令部正式签署投降书。

en.s: Convoy PQ 12 (1–12 March 1942) was an Arctic convoy sent from Reykjavík in Iceland by the Allies to Murmansk, to supply the Soviet Union during the Second World War. The Germans conducted Operation Sportpalast with the battleship Tirpitz and three destroyers against the convoys but found neither. The Home Fleet attempted to intercept the German flotilla but in the fog and storms both sides lacked the air reconnaissance necessary to find their opponents during the passage of the convoys.

zh.s: PQ 12船队于1942年3月1日至12日从冰岛雷克雅未克驶往摩尔曼斯克，是二战期间盟军为苏联运送物资的北极船队。德军派出“提尔皮茨”号战列舰和三艘驱逐舰执行“体育宫行动”，试图袭击船队，但没有找到目标。英国本土舰队曾试图拦截德军舰队，但航行期间大雾和风暴让双方都无法进行必要的空中侦察。

en.t: Cold War: U.S. president Harry S. Truman proclaimed the Truman Doctrine to help stem the spread of communism
en.s: The Truman Doctrine is a U.S. foreign policy that pledges American support for U.S.-aligned nations against alleged authoritarian threats. The doctrine originated with the primary goal of countering the growth of the Soviet bloc during the Cold War. It was announced to Congress by President Harry S. Truman on March 12, 1947, and further developed on July 4, 1948, when he pledged to oppose the communist rebellions in Greece and Soviet demands on Turkey.

zh.s: 杜鲁门主义是美国的一项外交政策，承诺支持与美国结盟、面对所谓专制威胁的国家。该政策最初旨在遏制苏联阵营的扩张。哈里·S·杜鲁门总统于1947年3月12日在国会宣布这一政策；1948年7月4日，他进一步表示要反对希腊的共产主义起义和苏联对土耳其提出的要求。

en.s: The 1948–49 Scottish League Cup final was played on 12 March 1949, at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the third Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Rangers and Raith Rovers. Rangers won the match 2–0 thanks to goals by Torrance Gillick and Willie Paton.

zh.s: 1948—49赛季苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1949年3月12日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，这是该赛事第3届决赛，由流浪者对阵拉茨流浪者。凭借托兰斯·吉利克和威利·佩顿的进球，流浪者以2比0获胜。

en.s: Supreme Soviet elections were held in the Soviet Union on 12 March 1950.

zh.s: 苏联于1950年3月12日举行最高苏维埃选举。

en.s: The Llandow air disaster was an aircraft accident in Wales in 1950. At that time it was the world's worst air disaster, with a total of 80 fatalities. The aircraft, an Avro Tudor V, had been privately hired to fly rugby union enthusiasts to and from an international game in Ireland. On the return flight the aircraft stalled and crashed on its approach to land.

zh.s: 1950年威尔士发生兰道空难，是当时世界上死亡人数最多的航空事故，共造成80人死亡。事故飞机为阿夫罗·都铎V型客机，由私人包租，运送橄榄球爱好者往返爱尔兰参加一场国际比赛。返程途中，飞机失速并在降落时坠毁。

en.s: The Battle of Maehwa-San was fought for control of the hills and area around Maehwa mountain between the Hoengseong County and Wonju, between 7–12 March 1951, during the Korean War. The British Empire 27th British Commonwealth Brigade was tasked with eliminating the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) and Korean People's Army (KPA) forces occupying the area.

zh.s: 梅花山之战于1951年3月7日至12日朝鲜战争期间爆发，双方争夺横城郡与原州市之间的梅花山及周边地区。英国第27英联邦旅奉命消灭占据该地区的中国人民志愿军和朝鲜人民军部队。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in East Bengal between 8 and 12 March 1954, the first since Pakistan became an independent country in 1947. The opposition United Front, led by the All-Pakistan Awami League(Awami Muslim League) and Krishak Sramik Party, won a landslide victory with 223 of the 309 seats.

zh.s: 东孟加拉于1954年3月8日至12日举行议会选举，这是1947年巴基斯坦独立后的首次当地议会选举。由全巴基斯坦人民联盟（人民穆斯林联盟）和农工党领导的反对派联合阵线，赢得309席中的223席，取得压倒性胜利。

en.t: In the speech (delivered 12 March 1959 at the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference auditorium), he stated that Taiwan was part of China and Okinawa part of Japan, and argued that their separation from their respective mainlands resulted from American imperialism
en.s: Inejiro Asanuma (浅沼 稲次郎, Asanuma Inejirō; 27 December 1898 – 12 October 1960) was a Japanese politician and chairman of the Japan Socialist Party from 23 March 1960 until his assassination the same year. Known for his large stature and powerful voice, he tirelessly toured the country delivering speeches, earning him the nicknames "speech-making everyman" (enzetsu hyakushō), "human locomotive" (ningen kikan-sha), and the affectionate "Numa-san".

zh.t: 他在讲话中称台湾是中国的一部分、冲绳是日本的一部分，并认为两地脱离各自本土是美国帝国主义造成的（讲话于1959年3月12日在中国人民政治协商会议礼堂发表）
zh.s: 浅沼稻次郎（日文：浅沼 稲次郎，Asanuma Inejirō；1898年12月27日—1960年10月12日）是日本政治家，1960年3月23日起担任日本社会党主席，直至同年遇刺身亡。他身材高大、嗓音洪亮，曾不知疲倦地走遍全国发表演讲，因此有“演说界的平民”（enzetsu hyakushō）、“人体机车”（ningen kikan-sha）等绰号，人们也亲切地称他为“沼先生”。

en.s: French legislative elections took place on 5 and 12 March 1967 to elect the third National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. In December 1965, Charles de Gaulle was re-elected President of France in the first Presidential election by universal suffrage. However, contrary to predictions, there had been a second ballot. This election marked a process of rebuilding by the opposition. François Mitterrand's unexpected result, as De Gaulle's challenger in the second round of the presidential election, allowed him to establish himself as the leader of the non-Communist Left.

zh.s: 法国于1967年3月5日和12日举行议会选举，选出第五共和国的第三届国民议会。1965年12月，戴高乐在法国首次全民直选总统的选举中连任，但出乎预料，选举进入了第二轮。反对派也由此开始重组。弗朗索瓦·密特朗在总统选举第二轮中挑战戴高乐，取得超出预期的成绩，因而确立了自己作为非共产党左翼领袖的地位。

en.t: Suharto takes power from Sukarno when the Provisional People's Consultative Assembly inaugurate him as Acting President of Indonesia
en.s: The People's Consultative Assembly of the Republic of Indonesia is the supreme legislative body in Indonesia's political system. It is composed of the members of a lower body, the House of Representatives (DPR) and an upper body, the Regional Representative Council (DPD). Prior to 2004, and the amendments to the 1945 Constitution, the MPR was the supreme state organ of power in Indonesia.

zh.t: 临时人民协商会议推举苏哈托为印度尼西亚代总统，他由此从苏加诺手中掌权
zh.s: 印度尼西亚共和国人民协商会议是该国政治体制中的最高立法机构，由下院人民代表会议（DPR）和上院地方代表理事会（DPD）的成员组成。2004年之前、即1945年宪法修正案通过之前，人民协商会议是印度尼西亚的最高国家权力机关。

en.s: The 1968 New Hampshire Democratic presidential primary was held on March 12, 1968, in New Hampshire as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1968 United States presidential election. Although President Lyndon B. Johnson defeated Senator Eugene McCarthy in the non-binding presidential preference primary with 49% of the vote, McCarthy's superior organization allowed him to win twenty of the state's twenty-four pledged delegates; Johnson's poor performance in New Hampshire precipitated his decision not to run for re-election, which he announced on March 31.

zh.t: 1968年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1968年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选于3月12日举行，是民主党为该年美国总统选举挑选候选人的州级提名竞选之一。在不具约束力的候选人偏好投票中，林登·B.约翰逊总统以49%的得票率击败参议员尤金·麦卡锡，但麦卡锡凭借更出色的组织工作，赢得该州24个须表态支持候选人的代表名额中的20个。约翰逊在新罕布什尔州的糟糕表现，促使他决定放弃竞选连任，并于3月31日宣布这一决定。

en.s: The 1968 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary was held on March 12, 1968, in New Hampshire as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1968 United States presidential election. While the nomination itself was contested, former Vice President Richard Nixon ran virtually unopposed in the Granite State, thus winning in a landslide. He defeated his nearest opponent, Nelson Rockefeller, (who was a write-in candidate) by 67 percentage points.

zh.t: 1968年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 1968年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选于3月12日举行，是共和党为该年美国总统选举挑选候选人的州级提名竞选之一。虽然全国范围的提名竞争仍在继续，但前副总统理查德·尼克松在新罕布什尔州几乎没有对手，以压倒性优势获胜。他领先最接近的对手纳尔逊·洛克菲勒67个百分点；洛克菲勒依靠选民在选票上自行填写姓名的方式参选。

en.s: On March 12, 1968, Mauritius gained independence from the United Kingdom.
en.n: Independence in 1968 was separate from becoming a republic in 1992.

zh.s: 1968年3月12日，毛里求斯脱离英国统治，成为独立国家。
zh.n: 1968年独立与1992年成为共和国是不同的事件。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Syria on 12 March 1971. There was only one candidate, Hafez al-Assad, with voters asked to approve or reject his candidacy. A reported 99% of voters voted in favour, with a turnout of 95%. These were the first elections to ever take place in Ba'athist Syria, which was established in 1963 following the 1963 coup that brought the Ba'ath Party to power.

zh.s: 叙利亚于1971年3月12日举行总统选举。唯一候选人为哈菲兹·阿萨德，选民只能投票赞成或反对。据公布结果，99%的选民投赞成票，投票率为95%。这是复兴党于1963年通过政变上台后，叙利亚首次举行选举。

en.s: The 1971 Turkish military memorandum (Turkish: 12 Mart Muhtırası), issued on 12 March that year, was the second military intervention to take place in the Republic of Turkey, coming 11 years after its 1960 predecessor. It is known as the "coup by memorandum", which the military delivered in lieu of sending out tanks, as it had done previously.

zh.s: 1971年土耳其军方备忘录（土耳其语：12 Mart Muhtırası）于当年3月12日发布，是土耳其共和国继1960年之后发生的第二次军事干预。由于军方以备忘录而非像上次那样出动坦克的方式施压，这一事件也被称为“备忘录政变”。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 12 March 1989. Incumbent President Didier Ratsiraka of AREMA won with over 60% of the vote. Voter turnout was 81.04% of the 5,741,974 registered voters.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于1989年3月12日举行总统选举。马达加斯加复兴先锋党的现任总统迪迪埃·拉齐拉卡获得超过60%的选票，赢得选举。在5,741,974名登记选民中，投票率为81.04%。

en.s: The 1993 Bombay bombings were a series of 12 bomb explosions that took place in Bombay, India on 12 March 1993. The coordinated attacks were the most destructive bomb explosions in Indian history. This was first of its kind serial-bomb-blasts across the world. The single-day attacks resulted in 257 fatalities and 717 injuries. Thirteen blasts were announced by the then Chief Minister of Maharashtra Sharad Pawar, the fictitious one in a Muslim quarter of the city, to prevent the events from taking on a communal hue. The attacks were coordinated by Dawood Ibrahim, don of the Mumbai-based international organised crime syndicate named D-Company.

zh.s: 1993年3月12日，印度孟买发生12起相互协调的炸弹爆炸，造成257人死亡、717人受伤，是印度历史上破坏最严重的炸弹袭击。原文称，这是世界上首次此类连环爆炸。当时的马哈拉施特拉邦首席部长沙拉德·帕瓦尔对外宣布发生13起爆炸，其中虚构了一起发生于穆斯林社区的爆炸，以免事件激化宗教社群冲突。袭击由达乌德·易卜拉欣统筹，他是总部位于孟买的跨国有组织犯罪集团‘D公司’的头目。

en.t: Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons
en.s: The Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons, commonly known as the Non-Proliferation Treaty or NPT, is an international treaty, the objective of which is to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons and weapons technology, to promote cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy, and to further the goal of achieving nuclear disarmament and general and complete disarmament.
en.n: North Korea announces that it will withdraw from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons and refuses to allow inspectors access to its nuclear sites.

zh.t: 朝鲜宣布退出《不扩散核武器条约》
zh.s: 《不扩散核武器条约》通常简称《不扩散条约》或NPT，是一项国际条约，旨在防止核武器及相关技术扩散，促进和平利用核能方面的合作，并推动核裁军和全面彻底裁军。
zh.n: 朝鲜宣布将退出《不扩散核武器条约》，并拒绝让核查人员进入其核设施。

en.s: The 1994 North Korean nuclear crisis was a crisis on the Korean Peninsula, mainly revolving around North Korea's nuclear program. Largely caused by North Korea's announcement that it would withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) in 1993, the tensions could have led to a war between North Korea and the US, had it not been for an agreement reached between former US President Jimmy Carter and then-North Korean Leader Kim Il Sung.

zh.s: 1994年朝鲜核危机是朝鲜半岛的一场危机，焦点主要在朝鲜的核计划。朝鲜于1993年宣布退出《不扩散核武器条约》，引发了紧张局势；若非美国前总统吉米·卡特与时任朝鲜领导人金日成达成协议，局势可能导致朝鲜与美国开战。

en.s: The 1994 Fremantle by-election was held in the Australian federal electorate of Fremantle in Western Australia on 12 March 1994. The by-election was triggered by the retirement of the sitting member, the Australian Labor Party's John Dawkins, on 4 February 1994. The writ for the by-election was issued on the same day.

zh.s: 1994年3月12日，澳大利亚联邦西澳大利亚州弗里曼特尔选区举行补选。补选由时任议员、澳大利亚工党成员约翰·道金斯于1994年2月4日退休引发，补选令状也在当天发出。

en.s: The 1997 Saint Angelo Chinese Football Super Cup (Chinese: 1997年报喜鸟中国足球超霸杯赛) was the 3rd Chinese Football Super Cup, contested by Chinese Jia-A League 1997 winners Dalian Wanda and 1997 Chinese FA Cup winners Beijing Guoan. Andrés Olivas scored the first golden goal in the Chinese football history, which ensured Beijing Guoan win their first Chinese Football Super Cup title.

zh.s: 1997年圣安杰洛中国足球超霸杯是第三届中国足球超霸杯，由1997年甲A联赛冠军大连万达和1997年中国足协杯冠军北京国安对阵。安德烈斯·奥利瓦斯打进中国足球历史上的首个金球，帮助北京国安首次夺得超霸杯冠军。

en.s: The 2000 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 12 March 2000, to elect the 7th Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 259 seats in the Senate. While most opinion polls gave him a clear victory, the incumbent People's Party of Prime Minister José María Aznar was elected to a second term in office with a surprising absolute majority of 183: a 27-seat gain from the previous election: a rise from opinion polls which gave him a plurality victory only.

zh.s: 2000年西班牙大选于3月12日星期日举行，选出西班牙王国第7届议会，改选众议院全部350席，以及参议院259席中的208席。尽管多数民调已预计总理何塞·玛丽亚·阿斯纳尔领导的执政党人民党会明显获胜，但该党最终赢得183席，取得出人意料的绝对多数，较上届增加27席，开始第二届执政任期。民调此前只预计人民党取得相对多数。

en.s: Living Dangerously (2000) was the third and final Living Dangerously professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). It took place on March 12, 2000 from the O'Neill Center in Danbury, Connecticut. The commentator for the event was Joey Styles. The main event was a tournament final match for the vacant World Television Championship, which had been vacated by previous champion Rob Van Dam due to an injury.

zh.s: 2000年‘危险生活’是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第3届、也是最后一届同名按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月12日在康涅狄格州丹伯里的奥尼尔中心举行，由乔伊·斯泰尔斯解说。压轴赛是争夺空缺的世界电视冠军头衔的锦标赛决赛。此前的冠军罗布·范·达姆因伤交出了头衔。

en.s: The 2000 Nevada Democratic presidential caucuses took place on March 12, 2000, as part of the 2000 presidential primaries for the 2000 presidential election. 20 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention were allocated to the presidential candidates. Former Vice President AI Gore won the contest.

zh.t: 2000年内华达州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2000年内华达州民主党总统党团会议于3月12日举行，是该年总统提名初选的一部分，向总统候选人分配20个民主党全国代表大会代表名额。阿尔·戈尔赢得此次竞选；原文将其职务写为‘前副总统’。

en.s: A regional election was held in Andalusia on 12 March 2000 to elect the 6th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 109 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with the 2000 Spanish general election. The ruling Spanish Socialist Workers' Party of Andalusia (PSOE–A) of Manuel Chaves won with a relative majority of 52 and was re-elected for a fourth term as president of the Regional Government of Andalusia with the support of the Andalusian Party (PA).

zh.s: 安达卢西亚于2000年3月12日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区议会第六届议员，全部109个席位均需改选。选举与2000年西班牙大选同时举行。曼努埃尔·查韦斯领导的安达卢西亚西班牙工人社会党赢得52席，成为相对多数党；在安达卢西亚党的支持下，查韦斯第四次当选自治区政府主席。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Uganda on 12 March 2001. The result was a victory for incumbent Yoweri Museveni, who won 69% of the vote. All candidates were independents, as political parties were banned at the time. Voter turnout was 70.3%.

zh.s: 乌干达于2001年3月12日举行总统选举。现任总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼以69%的得票率获胜。当时政党被禁止活动，因此所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。投票率为70.3%。

en.s: The 2001 Alberta general election was held on March 12, 2001 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. The incumbent Alberta Progressive Conservative Party, led by Ralph Klein, won a strong majority for its tenth consecutive term in government. In addition to increasing its share of the popular vote to almost 62%, the PC Party won a majority of seats in Edmonton for the first time since 1982.

zh.s: 2001年艾伯塔省大选于2001年3月12日举行，选出艾伯塔省立法议会议员。拉尔夫·克莱因领导的现任进步保守党赢得压倒性多数，连续第十次执政。该党得票率接近62%，并自1982年以来首次在埃德蒙顿赢得过半席位。

en.s: The 2002 Tulsa mayoral election was held on March 12, 2002, in order to elect the mayor of Tulsa, Oklahoma. Partisan primary elections were held on February 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic mayor Susan Savage decided not to run for re-election. The subsequent open seat was won by Republican nominee Bill LaFortune.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州塔尔萨于2002年3月12日举行市长选举，各党初选于2月5日进行。现任民主党市长苏珊·萨维奇决定不再寻求连任，共和党候选人比尔·拉福琼赢得这个没有现任者参选的职位。

en.s: Zoran Đinđić, the sixth Prime Minister of the Republic of Serbia, was assassinated on Wednesday 12 March 2003, in Belgrade, Serbia. Đinđić was fatally shot by a sniper while exiting his vehicle outside of the back entrance of the Serbian government headquarters. A state of emergency was immediately declared in the country, and during the police "Operation Sabre", more than 11,000 people associated with organized criminal groups were detained.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚共和国第6任总理佐兰·金吉奇于2003年3月12日星期三在贝尔格莱德遇刺。他在塞尔维亚政府总部后门外下车时遭狙击手射杀。全国随即进入紧急状态，警方在‘军刀行动’中拘留了超过11,000名与有组织犯罪集团有关的人。

en.s: The current conflict in the Niger Delta first arose in the early 1990s over tensions between foreign oil corporations and a number of the Niger Delta's minority ethnic groups who feel they are being exploited, particularly the Ogoni and the Ijaw. Ethnic and political unrest continued throughout the 1990s despite the return to democracy and the election of the Obasanjo government in 1999.

zh.s: 尼日尔三角洲当前的冲突最早于20世纪90年代初出现，起因是外国石油公司与当地若干少数族群之间的紧张关系；这些族群认为自己遭到剥削，尤其包括奥戈尼人和伊乔人。尽管尼日利亚恢复民主，并于1999年选举产生奥巴桑乔政府，整个90年代的族群和政治动荡仍在持续。

en.s: Zoran Đinđić (1 August 1952 – 12 March 2003) was a Serbian politician and philosopher who served as the prime minister of Serbia from 2001 until his assassination in 2003. He was the mayor of Belgrade in 1997, becoming the first non-communist and first democratically elected official to hold both key positions after World War II. Đinđić was a long-time opposition politician and held a doctorate in philosophy.

zh.s: 佐兰·金吉奇（1952年8月1日—2003年3月12日）是塞尔维亚政治家和哲学家，2001年至2003年担任塞尔维亚总理，后遭暗杀。他于1997年担任贝尔格莱德市长，是二战后首位担任这两个重要职务的非共产党人士，也是首位民选官员。金吉奇长期从事反对派政治活动，拥有哲学博士学位。

en.s: The 2006 Destination X was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on March 12, 2006 from the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the second event under the Destination X chronology. Eight matches were featured on the event's card. In October 2017, with the launch of the Global Wrestling Network, the event became available to stream on demand.

zh.s: 2006年‘X目的地’是TNA摔角联盟举办的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月12日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone场馆举行。这是该系列第2届赛事，赛程共安排8场比赛。2017年10月，随着全球摔角网络上线，该赛事录像可供网络点播。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 12 March 2009. The result was a victory for the United Progressive Party, which won nine of the seventeen elected seats in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于2009年3月12日举行大选。联合进步党赢得众议院17个民选席位中的9席，取得胜利。

en.s: The Rey de Reyes 2009 (Spanish for "King of Kings") was a major annual professional wrestling show that also hosted that year's version of the Rey de Reyes tournament, produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA). The show took place on March 12, 2010 in Querétaro, Mexico at Plaza de Toros Santa Maria in Querétaro, Querétaro, Mexico. The event was the 14th event produced under the Rey de Reyes name and also the 14th time that the Rey de Reyes tournament was held. The 2010 Rey de Reyes tournament saw Chessman win the title by defeating Marco Corleone and Hernandez.

zh.s: 2010年‘王中之王’是墨西哥AAA摔角联盟举办的大型年度职业摔角赛事，同时举行当年的王中之王锦标赛。赛事于2010年3月12日在墨西哥克雷塔罗州克雷塔罗市的圣玛丽亚斗牛场举行。这是第14次以‘王中之王’为名举办的赛事，也是第14届同名锦标赛。Chessman击败Marco Corleone和Hernandez，赢得2010年锦标赛头衔。原文开头将赛事年份写为2009年，与后文的2010年日期不一致。

en.s: A special election for Cagayan's 2nd district seat in the House of Representatives of the Philippines was held on March 12, 2011. The special election was called after the incumbent representative, Florencio Vargas died in July 2010. Vargas' daughter, Baby Aline Vargas-Alfonso, was elected after beating former Cagayan Governor Edgar Lara, Vargas' opponent in the 2010 election. Alfonso would then serve the remainder of her father's term which ended in 2013.

zh.t: 2011年卡加延省第2国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 菲律宾卡加延省第2选区于2011年3月12日举行众议员特别选举。现任议员弗洛伦西奥·巴尔加斯于2010年7月去世，因此须进行补选。他的女儿贝比·阿琳·巴尔加斯-阿方索击败前卡加延省省长埃德加·拉拉当选，接任父亲至2013年届满的剩余任期。拉拉也是她父亲在2010年选举中的对手。

en.t: A reactor at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant explodes and releases radioactivity into the atmosphere a day after the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami
en.s: The Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant (福島第一原子力発電所, Fukushima Daiichi Genshiryoku Hatsudensho; Fukushima number 1 nuclear power plant) is a disabled nuclear power plant located on a 350-hectare (860-acre) site in the towns of Ōkuma and Futaba in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. The plant suffered major damage from the magnitude 9.1 earthquake and tsunami that hit Japan on March 11, 2011.

zh.t: 2011年东北地方地震与海啸发生一天后，福岛第一核电站一座反应堆爆炸，放射性物质泄漏到大气中
zh.s: 福岛第一核电站（日文：福島第一原子力発電所，Fukushima Daiichi Genshiryoku Hatsudensho；意为福岛一号核电站）是一座已停运的核电站，占地350公顷（860英亩），位于日本福岛县大熊町和双叶町。2011年3月11日，日本发生里氏9.1级地震和海啸，该核电站因此遭受严重损坏。

en.s: Fight Nights: Battle of Moscow 3 was a mixed martial arts and kickboxing event held on 12 March 2011 in Moscow, Russia.

zh.s: 2011年3月12日，Fight Nights在俄罗斯莫斯科举办“莫斯科之战3”，赛事包括综合格斗和踢拳比赛。

en.t: The northernmost section opened on 12 March 2011, enabling through services to Shin-Ōsaka Station (and, with an interchange, to Tōkyō Station)
en.s: The Kyushu Shinkansen (Japanese: 九州新幹線, Hepburn: Kyūshū Shinkansen) is a Japanese high-speed rail line and part of the nationwide Shinkansen network. It is an extension of the San'yō Shinkansen from Honshu, connecting Hakata Station in the city of Fukuoka on Japan's island of Kyūshū to Kagoshima-Chuo Station in the city of Kagoshima in the south.

zh.s: 九州新干线是日本高速铁路线路，也是全国新干线网络的一部分。它从本州岛上的山阳新干线延伸而来，连接九州岛福冈市的博多站和鹿儿岛市的鹿儿岛中央站。九州新干线最北段于2011年3月12日开通，列车由此可直达新大阪站，并可换乘前往东京站。

en.s: On 12 March 2013, a party of Islamist rebels ambushed a squadron of Chadian soldiers during "clean-up operations" in the Adrar des Ifoghas mountains. Heavy gunfire was exchanged between the two leading to a brief standoff. A soldier was killed by a stray bullet during the confrontation that also led to the deaths of six rebels. A pick-up truck was taken with five Islamists.

zh.s: 2013年3月12日，一群伊斯兰主义叛军在伊福加斯山脉伏击了执行‘清剿行动’的一支乍得士兵分队。双方猛烈交火，随后短暂对峙。一名士兵被流弹击中身亡，另有6名叛军死亡。行动中还缴获一辆皮卡车，并俘获5名伊斯兰主义武装人员。

en.s: On March 12, 2014, an explosion occurred at 9:31 a.m. in the East Harlem neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City, United States. The explosion leveled two apartment buildings located just north of 116th Street at 1644 and 1646 Park Avenue, killing eight people, injuring at least 70 others, and displacing 100 families. City officials initially pointed to a gas leak as the cause of the blast. In June 2015, the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) blamed the explosion on failures by Consolidated Edison and the city.

zh.s: 2014年3月12日上午9时31分，美国纽约市曼哈顿东哈莱姆发生爆炸，将位于116街以北、公园大道1644号和1646号的两栋公寓楼夷为平地，造成8人死亡、至少70人受伤，100户家庭失去住所。市政府官员最初认为爆炸由燃气泄漏引起。2015年6月，美国国家运输安全委员会认定，联合爱迪生公司和市政府的失误导致了爆炸。

en.s: Roadblock was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE, an American promotion, that aired exclusively on the WWE Network. The event's name was a reference to its position on the "Road to WrestleMania". The inaugural event took place on March 12, 2016 at the Ricoh Coliseum in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Nine matches (including two dark matches) were contested on the event. The main event saw Triple H defeat Dean Ambrose to retain his WWE World Heavyweight Championship. In July 2016, a second event was revealed to take place on December 18, 2016 at the PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, as a Raw-exclusive pay-per-view with TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs (2016) becoming a SmackDown-exclusive pay-per-view event.

zh.s: ‘路障’是美国WWE摔角联盟举办、由WWE Network独家播出的职业摔角赛事，名称指其在‘通往摔角狂热之路’这一赛程中的位置。首届赛事于2016年3月12日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的理光体育馆举行，共有9场比赛，包括2场不对外转播的比赛。压轴赛中，Triple H击败迪恩·安布罗斯，卫冕WWE世界重量级冠军。2016年7月，WWE宣布第二场路障赛事将于12月18日在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的PPG涂料竞技场举行，作为Raw品牌独享的按次付费赛事；同年的‘桌梯椅大赛’则成为SmackDown品牌独享的按次付费赛事。

en.t: World Series of Fighting 29: Gaethje vs. Foster
en.s: World Series of Fighting 29: Gaethje vs. Foster was a mixed martial arts event held on March 12, 2016 (2016-03-12) at the Bank of Colorado Arena in Greeley, Colorado.

zh.t: 世界格斗系列赛29：盖奇对阵福斯特
zh.s: 世界格斗系列赛29：盖奇对阵福斯特是一场综合格斗赛事，于2016年3月12日在科罗拉多州格里利的科罗拉多银行体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2016 Guam Republican presidential caucuses took place on March 12 in the U.S. territory of Guam as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. On the same day, the Republican Party held their Washington, D.C. caucus, while the Democratic Party held a caucus in the Northern Mariana Islands. The Democratic Party's own Guam caucus was held on May 7, 2016.

zh.t: 2016年关岛共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2016年3月12日，关岛举行共和党总统党团会议，是共和党总统初选的一部分。同日，共和党也在华盛顿特区举行党团会议，民主党则在北马里亚纳群岛举行党团会议。关岛民主党的党团会议于2016年5月7日举行。

en.s: The 2017 Indonesia President's Cup final was a football match that determined the winner of the 2017 Indonesia President's Cup. The match was held at the Pakansari Stadium in Bogor on 12 March 2017.

en.s: US-Bangla Airlines Flight 211 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka, Bangladesh, to Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, Nepal, that crashed on 12 March 2018 while landing, killing 51 of the 71 people aboard. The aircraft, a 76-seat Bombardier Q400 operated by US-Bangla Airlines, burst into flames after the crash. The 20 surviving passengers were badly injured from the impact and the fire.

zh.t: 孟加拉优速航空211号航班空难
zh.s: 孟加拉优速航空211号航班是从孟加拉国达卡沙阿贾拉勒国际机场飞往尼泊尔加德满都特里布万国际机场的定期国际客运航班。2018年3月12日，该航班降落时坠毁，机上71人中有51人遇难。执飞飞机是孟加拉优速航空的一架76座庞巴迪Q400，坠毁后起火。20名幸存乘客均因撞击和火灾严重受伤。

en.s: The 2018–19 Phoenix mayoral special election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the new Mayor of Phoenix, Arizona. The election was officially nonpartisan; candidates ran on the same ballot. In the initial round of the election, since no candidate reached 50 percent plus one vote (as required by Phoenix City Charter), a runoff election was held on March 12, 2019, between the top two finishers.

en.s: On March 12, 2020, Islamic State in the Greater Sahara militants attacked an outpost of the National Guard of Niger in Ayorou, Niger, killing several soldiers. French and Nigerien counterattacks killed dozens of ISGS militants.

zh.s: 2020年3月12日，‘大撒哈拉伊斯兰国’武装分子袭击尼日尔阿约鲁的一处国民警卫队哨所，造成数名士兵死亡。法国和尼日尔随后反击，击毙数十名该组织武装分子。

en.s: The 2021 President's Cup was the seventh President's Cup contested for. The match was played on 12 March between the champions of the 2020 League of Ireland Premier Division and 2020 FAI Cup, Shamrock Rovers and Dundalk. The match finished 1–1 after 90 minutes and was decided by a penalty shootout which Dundalk won 4–3 with Albanian goalkeeper Alessio Abibi saving Roberto Lopes penalty to win the game for Dundalk on his competitive debut.

zh.s: 第七届爱尔兰总统杯于3月12日举行，由2020年爱尔兰超级联赛冠军沙姆洛克流浪者队对阵2020年爱尔兰足协杯冠军邓多克队。双方90分钟内战成1比1，邓多克在点球大战中以4比3获胜。阿尔巴尼亚门将阿莱西奥·阿比比在其代表球队的正式比赛首秀中扑出了罗伯托·洛佩斯的点球，帮助邓多克夺冠。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Turkmenistan on 12 March 2022. The elections were called after incumbent president Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedow announced his intention to resign, having already announced on 25 January 2020, that he would not seek re-election to a fourth term, leaving the office open for the first time since 2007, when Berdimuhamedow was first elected, following the death of president-for-life Saparmurat Niyazov on 21 December 2006.

zh.s: 土库曼斯坦于2022年3月12日提前举行总统选举。现任总统古尔班古力·别尔德穆哈梅多夫宣布准备辞职后，选举随即安排举行。他早在2020年1月25日就已宣布不寻求第四个任期。这是自2007年以来首次没有现任总统参选。终身总统萨帕尔穆拉特·尼亚佐夫于2006年12月21日去世后，别尔德穆哈梅多夫于2007年首次当选。

en.s: Bellator 276: Borics vs. Burnell was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on March 12, 2022, at the Family Arena in St. Louis, Missouri, United States.

zh.s: ‘Bellator 276：博里奇对伯内尔’是Bellator综合格斗联盟举办的赛事，于2022年3月12日在美国密苏里州圣路易斯的家庭竞技场举行。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Santos vs. Ankalaev
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Santos vs. Ankalaev (also known as UFC Fight Night 203 and UFC on ESPN+ 61 or UFC Vegas 50) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on March 12, 2022 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：桑托斯对安卡拉耶夫
zh.s: ‘UFC格斗之夜：桑托斯对安卡拉耶夫’又称‘UFC格斗之夜203’、‘UFC ESPN+第61场’或‘UFC拉斯维加斯50’，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2022年3月12日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2022 Johor state election, formally the 15th Johor general election, took place on 12 March 2022. The election was to elect 56 members of the 15th Johor State Legislative Assembly. The previous assembly was dissolved on 22 January 2022. The state election was conducted in the midst of the 2020–2022 Malaysian political crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

zh.s: 2022年柔佛州选举正式名称为第15届柔佛州大选，于2022年3月12日举行，选出柔佛州立法议会第15届的56名议员。上一届议会于2022年1月22日解散。选举在2020—2022年马来西亚政治危机和新冠疫情期间举行。

en.s: The battle of Volnovakha was a military engagement that lasted from 25 February 2022 until 12 March 2022 on the eastern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Russian and Donetsk People's Republic (DPR) forces engaged Ukrainian forces at the small city of Volnovakha in Donetsk Oblast, which was located close to the pre-invasion front line.

en.s: During the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a military engagement took place at Brovary, an eastern suburb of Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine. Russian forces advanced west from southern Chernihiv Oblast and were engaged by Ukrainian forces. Russian forces withdrew from the area by 1-2 April 2022.

en.s: The 2024 Washington Democratic presidential primary was held on March 12, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside the Georgia, Mississippi and Northern Mariana Islands primaries. 92 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 19 additional unpledged delegates. President Joe Biden succeeded over the option for "Uncommitted Delegates" and challengers Marianne Williamson and Dean Phillips.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州民主党总统初选于3月12日举行，与佐治亚州、密西西比州及北马里亚纳群岛的初选同日进行，是民主党为当年总统选举挑选候选人的一部分。此次分配92个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，另有19名无需预先承诺支持特定候选人的代表。乔·拜登总统击败‘不承诺支持任何候选人的代表’这一选项，以及玛丽安娜·威廉森和迪安·菲利普斯两名挑战者。

en.s: The 2024 Mississippi Democratic presidential primary took place on March 12, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside the Georgia and Washington and Northern Mariana Islands primaries. 35 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in an open primary, with 5 additional unpledged delegates. Incumbent President Joe Biden was the only candidate that met the requirements to appear on the ballot.

zh.t: 2024年密西西比州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年密西西比州民主党总统初选于3月12日举行，与佐治亚州、华盛顿州及北马里亚纳群岛的初选同日进行，是民主党为当年总统选举挑选候选人的一部分。这场开放式初选分配35个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，另有5名无需预先承诺支持特定候选人的代表。现任总统乔·拜登是唯一符合条件、姓名列在选票上的候选人。

en.s: The 2024 Hawaii Republican presidential caucuses were held on March 12, 2024, from 6pm to 8pm, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 19 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Georgia, Mississippi, and Washington.

zh.t: 2024年夏威夷州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2024年夏威夷州共和党总统党团会议于3月12日18时至20时举行，是共和党为当年总统选举挑选候选人的一部分。此次按比例分配19个共和党全国代表大会代表名额，与佐治亚州、密西西比州和华盛顿州的初选同日进行。

en.s: The 2024 Washington Republican presidential primary were held on March 12, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 43 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Georgia, Hawaii, and Mississippi.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州共和党总统初选于2024年3月12日举行，是共和党2024年总统候选人初选的一部分。43名共和党全国代表大会代表按比例分配。当天佐治亚州、夏威夷州和密西西比州也举行了初选。

en.s: The 2024 Georgia Democratic presidential primary was held on March 12, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside two more states and one territory. 108 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in an open primary, with additional 15 unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2024年佐治亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州民主党总统初选于2024年3月12日举行，是民主党2024年总统候选人初选的一部分；当天还有两个州和一个属地举行初选。初选开放给所有选民，分配108名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有15名无约束代表。

en.s: The 2024 Georgia Republican presidential primary election was held on March 12, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 59 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Hawaii, Mississippi, and Washington.

zh.t: 2024年佐治亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州共和党总统初选于2024年3月12日举行，是共和党2024年总统候选人初选的一部分。59名共和党全国代表大会代表按胜者全得方式分配。当天夏威夷州、密西西比州和华盛顿州也举行了初选。

en.s: General elections were held in Belize on 12 March 2025 to elect the 31 members of the House of Representatives. The incumbent government under the People's United Party (PUP) won a second term in office against a divided opposition United Democratic Party (UDP).

zh.s: 伯利兹于2025年3月12日举行大选，选出众议院31名议员。执政的人民统一党击败内部分裂的反对党联合民主党，赢得第二届执政任期。

en.s: After the resignation of federal councillor and defence minister Viola Amherd, Martin Pfister was elected to the Swiss Federal Council on 12 March 2025. As per an informal agreement between the major political parties known as the magic formula, the only candidates were from Amherd's party, The Centre. Her successor will take over the leadership of the Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport (DDPS).

zh.s: 联邦委员兼国防部长薇奥拉·阿姆赫德辞职后，马丁·普菲斯特于2025年3月12日当选瑞士联邦委员。按照主要政党之间称为‘神奇公式’的非正式权力分配协议，候选人全部来自阿姆赫德所属的中间党。接任者将领导联邦国防、民防与体育部。
